_doc: Frozen decoder parameters (mtah.decode). Chosen on external out-of-fold probabilities only (lgb_v1, 5 non-holdout DFL matches, degraded profile nominal, seeds 0+1) by minimax regret over the label views min_control(0 / 0.5 / 1.0 s), then the centre of the plateau; see docs/decoder.md. Nothing here was fitted to the target or its ground truth. Costs are in milli-nats (1000 = one nat of log-probability), durations in frames at 25 fps.
_cost_cap: Fixed, not tuned: p floor 0.01. Halving or doubling it changes the family score by < 0.0002.
_switch_cost: Tuned. Plateau 2000-4000 (family 0.641-0.647); 1000 -> 0.636, 8000 -> 0.637. One cost for every transition: separate costs for team changes and dead-ball boundaries gained < 0.001.
_min_poss: Tuned. Controlled possession: an opponent run shorter than 19 frames (0.76 s) is a touch, not a change (relabel.min_control on the decoded path; restart run exempt). Plateau 12-25 frames; 31 -> -0.006, 50 -> -0.025.
_min_dead: Tuned. A decoded dead-ball run shorter than 50 frames (2 s) returns to the team in possession. Plateau 50-75 frames.
_offsets: Measured, not tuned: median signed latency of matched transitions is 0 / -1 / 0 frames (team change / stop / restart), so no offset is applied.
_options_off: Tested with the paired rule (>= +0.01 mean gain, non-negative on >= 4 of 5 matches) and not adopted: onset-aware switch cost (+0.004), snap to onset peak (+0.003), both (+0.006), pruning of low-margin short spells (-0.008), hard minima inside the search (-0.003), dead bias (-0.001).
_tags: Smart Tagging priors: off. See docs/decoder.md.
